parameters.content:
## The engine
Every other workflow calls this one with an operation: tick, refills, prepare, handle, digest, read, action or reset.

It loads the whole household from one data table, runs the same rules the live demo runs in the browser, saves only the rows that changed, and hands back the texts to send. One place to change the rules, so the dashboard, the texts and the demo never disagree.
